title: Sticky/magnetic scrolling behavior is so frustrating
summary: ### Description After entering the Artist view, for instance, scrolling down will automatically slide the view down to center over the tracks and albums; then, if you scroll up and get too close to the header, the view will slide again to center over either the header or the track list. Same effect appears on album and playlist views; basically, anywhere there's a header. ### Problem solved This has caused misclicks here more than once, as the scrolling is taken out of our hands while near the header. I find it so disorientating, and I wish there was a way of turning it off and scrolling normally, predictably. ### Other implementations I've been testing a bunch of open source Android music players, such as VLC, Lune, Fossify Music and Chocola; but none of them have this scrolling feature. ### Benefit Better accessibility, I would say; but I don't know how others feel about this feature. ### Duplicates - [x] I have checked this feature request for duplicates. - [x] I have checked that this feature is not implemented in the [lastest version](https://github.com/OxygenCobalt/Auxio/releases). - [x] I have checked the [Why Are These Features Missing?](https://github.com/OxygenCobalt/Auxio/wiki/Why-Are-These-Features-Missing%3F) page. - [x] I agree to the [Contribution Guidelines](https://github.com/OxygenCobalt/Auxio/blob/dev/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md).
